description: Search the problems people have that Triremes lists, biggest first: each with its title, tier, how many reports and when the first and the last were, the day Triremes listed it, its summary as its page shows it, whether it is sold as a lead (businesses that have it) or an idea report, its price, how many times a lead has been sold and when it last was, and its page. Leads and idea reports are bought on that page.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the answer before, for the next page.

kind.description: Only leads, or only idea reports.

max_sold.description: Only leads sold at most this many times; 0 for those never sold.

query.description: Words to find in a problem's title or summary; empty for every problem.

name: search_problems
title: Search problems
